title: Corteva, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Corteva, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing executive leadership appointments for its planned spin-off of the seed business (SpinCo) from the remaining crop protection business (New Corteva). The filing details named executive officer transitions and new hires including Luther Kissam as CEO of New Corteva.
key_points: Corteva announced on October 1, 2025 its intent to spin off its seed business from its crop protection business into two independent publicly traded companies
Effective at spin-off, CEO Charles V. Magro, CFO David P. Johnson, CTO Samuel R. Eathington, and Judd M. O'Connor will resign from Corteva and join SpinCo
Board appointed Luther Kissam, age 61, as CEO of New Corteva effective at spin-off; he will join the company June 1, 2026 as CEO of Crop Protection Business Unit prior to spin-off
Kissam's employment agreement includes annual base salary of $1,200,000, short-term incentive opportunity of 150% of base salary, and one-time equity award of $3,750,000 for 2026
Jeff Rudolph appointed CFO of New Corteva effective at spin-off; Brook Cunningham appointed Chief Commercial Officer; Ralph Ford appointed Chief Integrated Operations Officer
